pairs.subject: generated-music-acceptance
pairs.evidence: lib/music/elevenlabs.ts:275 The service returns generated audio after a byte-count check without measuring loudness, peaks or delivered structure, leaving the required technical acceptance gates unrealized.

techniques.evidence: lib/musicClient.ts:51 These files request and return generation results; they do not perform the first-listen acceptance event.
lib/music/elevenlabs.ts:271 The response check detects insufficient bytes, not a failed musical take requiring acoustic defect classification.
lib/music/elevenlabs.ts:275 Returned MP3 bytes have no integrated loudness, true-peak measurement, measurement basis or destination target.

lib/music/elevenlabs.ts:281 The generation record includes vendor, model, requested duration, plan and timestamp, but omits account, plan tier, applicable terms, reference status and clearance destination.
lib/music/elevenlabs.ts:279 This records the requested duration; returned audio is not measured against that duration, section offsets, locked tempo or ending shape.
